statement: EM SUPPLIES THE COMPLEX AND THE RECORD. Corner: the record space is the homology of EM's own complex — capacity 2^dim H_1, exact on/off manifolds (G-10). World: the record and its accumulated quantity are electromagnetic — PROVED encoding laws: NAND trapped charge one-signed for every pattern, DC-saturated CoCrPt moment one-signed, real data screening 0.00096 at N=1e5, sign fixed by the write mechanism (C-71, C-72). GAMMA SUPPLIES SPACE, WRITER, PROTECTION AND CHANNEL. Space (corner): capacity independent of protection (G-11); records on D(G) iff |G| is a power of 2, D_4 included (C-41, O-35). Writer (both): the admissible writer's weight IS the earned geometry — d_W a true metric of boundary-crossing cost, exhaustively closed (C-78); the one pure-Gamma separation law is w_min = d, confinement character; no pure-Gamma falloff exists — boundary law Gamma's, reach and falloff the coupling's (C-80). Protection (world): metastable barriers, all 13 census records, E_b/kT 50-780; degeneracy/homology protection a different mechanism (C-66); its corner form is the E_b -> infinity limit, DEF-A the verified limit (C-75). Channel (corner): the coupling makes the environment's evolution conditional on the record — the divergence IS the copy, value constant, not system-undoable (F-20); clause (ii) is a condition on the environment (C-17); a Gamma-priced coupling reaches exactly three classes: exponential below mu_c, the earned dimension's own point-source potential at mu_c, divergent above (C-87). Emergence (both): the Newton verdict is MATCHES AT MEMBER LEVEL — unique critical member computed; occupancy of criticality, design-point enforcement, norm selection not earned; never a claim that gravity is derived (C-77 per C-78/C-80/C-87). ALPHA SETS THE COST. Corner: symmetry degeneracy splits at first order, measured not proved, slope = d on five codes (O-2); formation threshold = destruction threshold = d at d=2 (F-11), the scaling proved for every stabiliser code and coupling (O-10). World: the cost appears as the barrier — each record's parameter-free drop time in k(t_m) set by its barrier and bias (C-86); whether alpha's VALUE enters through E_b is open (T-38).
